subject: Q3 Benefits Plan Changes — Review Needed
snippet: Christopher, attached is the draft for Q3 changes. Please review and provide feedback by EOD Thursday...
body:
Hi Christopher,

Attached is the draft document for Q3 benefits plan changes. This includes updates to deductibles and HSA contribution limits. Please review and provide feedback by EOD Thursday.

We have the vendor call Friday morning to discuss.

Best,
Sandra Chen

subject: Re: Q3 Benefits Plan Changes — Review Needed
snippet: Sandra — reviewed the draft. A few comments on the deductible tiers...
body:
Sandra,

Reviewed the draft. A few comments on the deductible tiers:
1. The PPO-HDHP transition needs a 30-day grace period
2. Can we lower the Family deductible by $100 to stay competitive?
3. The HSA language needs clearer enrollment deadlines

I'll send detailed markup by Wednesday morning.

Christopher
